repos.description: 🕷️ The BEST Web Scraping framework that handles everything from a single request to a full-scale crawl! Don't be shy, join here: https://discord.gg/EMgGbDceNQ and follow here for daily tips and tricks: https://x.com/Scrapling_dev
repos.summary_zh: Scrapling 是一个自适应网页抓取框架，能够处理从单请求到大规模爬取的全场景需求。其核心亮点在于智能解析器可学习网站变化并自动重定位元素，内置绕过 Cloudflare 等反爬系统的能力，支持并发多会话爬取、自动代理轮换和暂停恢复功能。提供实时统计、CLI 和 MCP 服务器集成，是现代 Web 数据采集的高效解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Scrapling is an adaptive web scraping framework designed to handle everything from simple single requests to complex large-scale crawling operations. Its standout feature is an intelligent parser that learns from website changes and automatically relocates elements when pages update. The framework includes built-in anti-bot bypass capabilities that defeat systems like Cloudflare Turnstile out of the box. It enables concurrent multi-session crawling with automatic proxy rotation, pause/resume functionality, and real-time streaming statistics. With integrated CLI tools and an MCP server, Scrapling offers a powerful yet straightforward solution for modern web data extraction at any scale.

repos.description: Browser automation CLI for AI agents
repos.summary_zh: Vercel Labs推出的AI代理浏览器自动化CLI工具，基于Rust构建提供毫秒级响应。核心亮点是通过无障碍树引用(@e1)实现AI友好的元素定位，支持点击、填充、截图等操作，为AI代理提供高效网页交互能力。
repos.summary_en: Rust CLI for AI browser automation with sub-millisecond speed. Features accessibility tree references (@e1) for AI-friendly element interaction, including clicks, form fills, and screenshots.

repos.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation
repos.summary_zh: Lightpanda 是为 AI 和自动化设计的开源无头浏览器，内存占用仅为 Chrome 的 1/9，执行速度快 11 倍。支持 JavaScript 和主流自动化框架，适用于网页爬虫、AI 代理和测试场景。
repos.summary_en: Lightpanda is an open-source headless browser designed specifically for AI and automation tasks. It dramatically reduces memory usage by 9x compared to Chrome while delivering 11x faster execution speeds. The browser supports JavaScript execution and Web APIs, and maintains compatibility with popular automation frameworks like Playwright, Puppeteer, and chromedp through the Chrome DevTools Protocol, making it ideal for web scraping, AI agent training, and automated testing.

repos.description: Playwright MCP server
repos.summary_zh: Playwright MCP是微软推出的Model Context Protocol服务器，通过Playwright可访问性树为LLM提供浏览器自动化能力。它摒弃截图方案，采用结构化快照实现确定性操作，适用于探索性测试、自愈脚本和长周期自治工作流。相比CLI工具，MCP模式更适合需要持久状态和深度页面推理的智能体场景。
repos.summary_en: Playwright MCP is a Microsoft Model Context Protocol server that enables LLMs to automate browsers through Playwright's accessibility tree. It replaces screenshot-based approaches with structured snapshots for deterministic, vision-free interactions. Designed for exploratory automation, self-healing tests, and persistent autonomous workflows, it maintains continuous browser context at the cost of higher token usage. The server integrates seamlessly with MCP-compatible clients including VS Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, and Windsurf, providing a lightweight yet powerful bridge between language models and web automation with rich introspection capabilities.

repos.description: The Open-Source Multimodal AI Agent Stack: Connecting Cutting-Edge AI Models and Agent Infra
repos.summary_zh: UI-TARS-desktop是字节跳动开源的多模态AI智能体桌面应用，基于UI-TARS视觉模型实现GUI自动化操作。支持本地与远程计算机及浏览器控制，无缝集成MCP工具链，通过自然语言指令完成跨应用任务。提供CLI与Web UI双模式，具备流式响应、运行时调试和沙箱隔离等企业级特性，为生产力自动化提供端到端解决方案。
repos.summary_en: UI-TARS-desktop is ByteDance's open-source multimodal AI agent desktop application powered by the UI-TARS vision model for GUI automation. It enables local and remote control of computers and browsers through natural language commands, seamlessly integrating with MCP tools for human-like task completion. Offering both CLI and Web UI interfaces, it features streaming responses, runtime performance statistics, Event Stream Viewer for debugging, and AIO Sandbox isolation. This enterprise-ready stack delivers a complete end-to-end solution for automating productivity workflows across desktop and web environments.

repos.description: The headless browser for AI agents and web scraping
repos.summary_zh: Obscura是用Rust编写的轻量级无头浏览器，专为AI智能体和网页爬虫设计。它内置V8引擎执行真实JavaScript，支持Chrome DevTools Protocol，完全兼容Puppeteer/Playwright API。相比Chrome，内存占用仅30MB（降低85%），启动瞬时，内置反检测功能，是自动化任务的理想选择。
repos.summary_en: Obscura is a lightweight headless browser engine written in Rust, purpose-built for AI agents and large-scale web scraping applications. It executes real JavaScript through the V8 engine, fully supports Chrome DevTools Protocol, and serves as a drop-in replacement for both Puppeteer and Playwright. Compared to traditional headless Chrome, Obscura reduces memory usage by 85% to just 30MB, achieves instant startup, and features built-in anti-detection mechanisms. This combination of performance, compatibility, and stealth makes it ideal for scalable browser automation tasks.

repos.description: Stealth Chromium that passes every bot detection test. Drop-in Playwright replacement with source-level fingerprint patches. 50+ tests passed.
repos.summary_zh: CloakBrowser 是一款源码级深度改造的隐身 Chromium 浏览器，通过 58 个 C++ 补丁从底层消除自动化指纹，完美绕过 Cloudflare Turnstile、reCAPTCHA v3 等 30+ 机器人检测系统。无缝兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer API，一行代码替换，内置类人行为模拟，为网页爬虫、数据采集和自动化测试提供终极反检测解决方案。
repos.summary_en: CloakBrowser is a stealth Chromium browser with 58 source-level C++ patches that fundamentally eliminate automation fingerprints. It achieves a 0.9 reCAPTCHA v3 score and passes 30+ bot detection tests including Cloudflare Turnstile and FingerprintJS. Offering seamless Playwright/Puppeteer API compatibility with one-line code replacement, built-in human-like behavior simulation, and automatic binary updates, it delivers the ultimate anti-detection solution for web scraping, data collection, and automation tasks.

repos.description: Make Any Website into CLI & Use your logged-in browser by AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: OpenCLI 是一款将任意网站转换为命令行接口的自动化工具，核心在于让 AI 智能体通过已登录的浏览器操作网页（导航、填表、点击、数据提取）。内置 Bilibili、知乎等适配器，通过浏览器扩展与本地守护进程实现安全交互，支持自定义命令扩展，并集成本地工具与 Electron 应用，实现高效自动化与 AI 驱动交互。
repos.summary_en: OpenCLI is an automation tool that converts any website into a command-line interface (CLI), enabling AI agents to operate websites via a logged-in browser for navigation, form filling, clicking, and data extraction. It provides built-in adapters for platforms like Bilibili and Zhihu, a browser extension with a local daemon, and allows custom command extensions. It also integrates local tools and Electron apps, serving as a versatile hub for human and AI-driven automation workflows.

repos.description: JavaScript in-page GUI agent. Control web interfaces with natural language.
repos.summary_zh: 阿里巴巴Page Agent是一个创新的页内JavaScript GUI代理框架，通过自然语言直接控制Web界面。其核心亮点在于纯前端实现，无需浏览器扩展或后端服务，基于文本化DOM操作避免截图和OCR依赖。支持接入任意LLM，提供人机协同UI，适用于SaaS智能助手、ERP/CRM表单自动填充、无障碍访问及多页面自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Alibaba Page Agent is an innovative in-page JavaScript GUI agent framework that controls web interfaces via natural language. Its key advantages include pure frontend implementation without browser extensions or backend services, direct DOM manipulation avoiding screenshots and OCR. It supports integration with any LLM, offers human-in-the-loop UI, and is ideal for SaaS AI copilots, smart form filling in ERP/CRM systems, accessibility enhancements, and cross-page automation.

repos.description: 🗃 Open source self-hosted web archiving. Takes URLs/browser history/bookmarks/Pocket/Pinboard/etc., saves HTML, JS, PDFs, media, and more...
repos.summary_zh: ArchiveBox 是一款开源自托管网页存档工具，支持从浏览器书签、历史记录、Pocket、Pinboard 等多源导入 URL，完整保存 HTML、JS、PDF、媒体文件等内容。采用标准化格式（WARC、SQLite、JSON）确保数据长期可读，提供 CLI、REST API 和 Webhook 集成能力。适用于个人知识管理、企业证据保全及数字资产备份，支持 Docker 快速部署。
repos.summary_en: ArchiveBox is an open-source self-hosted web archiving solution that preserves web content from URLs, browser history, bookmarks, Pocket, Pinboard, and more. It captures comprehensive snapshots including HTML, JavaScript, PDFs, and media files in standardized formats (WARC, SQLite, JSON) ensuring long-term accessibility. The tool offers CLI, REST API, and webhook integrations for automation, with Docker support for easy deployment. Ideal for personal knowledge management, legal evidence preservation, and social media backup, it gives users full control over their archived data.

repos.description: Automate browser based workflows with AI
repos.summary_zh: Skyvern 是基于 LLM 和计算机视觉的智能浏览器自动化平台，提供 Playwright 兼容 SDK 和无代码工作流构建器。通过视觉理解替代 XPath 定位，支持未知网站自动化、布局变更自适应，实现跨站点工作流批量执行，显著提升自动化鲁棒性。
repos.summary_en: Skyvern automates browsers using LLMs and vision. Playwright SDK replaces XPath with visual understanding for resilient cross-site workflows.

repos.description: Let Claude Code, Codex or Cursor use your real Chrome, logged in as you. One prompt to set up. Open source, MIT.
repos.summary_zh: Browser Harness 是一个自愈式浏览器控制框架，通过 Chrome DevTools Protocol 直连真实浏览器，让 LLM 自主完成任意网页任务。其核心创新在于动态生成缺失的辅助代码并持续学习优化，每次运行都自我改进。提供可复用的领域技能系统，支持从 LinkedIn 营销到电商下单等复杂自动化场景，架构精简仅千行代码。
repos.summary_en: Browser Harness is a self-healing browser automation framework that connects LLMs directly to real browsers via Chrome DevTools Protocol. Its core innovation lies in dynamically generating missing helper code during execution and continuously learning from each run. The framework features a reusable domain skills system for complex tasks like LinkedIn outreach and e-commerce ordering. With a minimal architecture of ~1k lines, it enables autonomous web task completion without predefined scripts, representing a new paradigm in LLM-driven browser automation.

repos.description: Turn any website into a structured API. Extract, automate, search and monitor the web.
repos.summary_zh: Maxun 是一款开源无代码网页数据平台，可将任意网站转化为结构化 API。它提供四大机器人类型：Extract（支持录制和 AI 自然语言提取）、Scrape（整页转 Markdown/HTML）、Crawl（全站爬取）和 Search（自动化搜索）。平台通过模拟真实用户行为，实现从简单到复杂的自动化数据采集，适用于 AI 工作流、竞品监控和商业智能等场景。
repos.summary_en: Maxun is an open-source no-code web data platform that transforms any website into structured APIs. It offers four robot types: Extract (with Recorder and AI natural language modes), Scrape (full-page to Markdown/HTML), Crawl (entire site crawling), and Search (automated web searches). By emulating real user behavior, it enables automated data collection workflows for AI pipelines, competitive intelligence, and business analytics.

repos.description: Self-evolving agent: grows skill tree from 3.3K-line seed, achieving full system control with 6x less token consumption
repos.summary_zh: GenericAgent是一个极简的自进化智能体框架，仅3K行核心代码，通过9个原子工具实现系统级控制（浏览器、终端、文件系统等）。它自动将任务执行路径固化为技能，形成个人技能树，支持多模型与跨平台，上下文窗口小于30K，显著降低token消耗与幻觉，提升任务成功率。
repos.summary_en: GenericAgent is a minimal self-evolving autonomous agent framework with only ~3K lines of core code. Through 9 atomic tools, it grants LLMs system-level control over browsers, terminals, filesystems, and more. It automatically crystallizes task execution paths into reusable skills, forming a personal skill tree. Supporting multiple models and cross-platform, it uses a <30K context window, reducing token consumption and hallucinations.

repos.description: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol (MCP) server that exposes your Chrome browser functionality to AI assistants like Claude, enabling complex browser automation, content analysis, and semantic search.
repos.summary_zh: Chrome MCP Server是一款基于Chrome扩展的Model Context Protocol服务器，让AI助手直接控制用户现有浏览器。核心优势在于复用日常Chrome环境的登录状态与配置，实现隐私优先的本地自动化。提供20+工具支持截图、网络监控、书签管理等，内置SIMD加速的向量数据库实现智能语义搜索，跨标签页上下文感知，适用于复杂浏览器自动化与内容分析场景。
repos.summary_en: Chrome MCP Server is a Chrome extension-based Model Context Protocol server that transforms your existing Chrome browser into an AI-controlled automation tool. Unlike Playwright-based solutions, it directly leverages your daily browser with preserved login states and configurations, ensuring privacy through local execution. It offers 20+ tools for screenshots, network monitoring, bookmark management, and more, plus SIMD-accelerated vector search for semantic content discovery. Cross-tab context awareness enables complex browser automation and intelligent content analysis for any LLM or chatbot client.

repos.description: Stealth headless browser for AI agents — bypass Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping. Drop-in Puppeteer/Playwright replacement.
repos.summary_zh: camofox-browser 是基于 Camoufox（C++ 层修改的 Firefox 内核）构建的反检测浏览器服务，专为 AI 智能体设计。它通过底层指纹欺骗（WebGL、AudioContext、硬件并发数等）绕过 Cloudflare 和反爬机制，提供 REST API 接口。相比 Playwright，内存占用低至 40MB，支持可访问性快照（比 HTML 小 90%）、会话隔离和搜索宏，是 Puppeteer/Playwright 的直接替代方案。
repos.summary_en: camofox-browser is a stealth headless browser service for AI agents, built on Camoufox—a Firefox fork with C++-level fingerprint spoofing. It bypasses Cloudflare, bot detection, and anti-scraping by patching navigator.hardwareConcurrency, WebGL, AudioContext, screen geometry, and WebRTC before JavaScript execution. Offering a REST API with 90% smaller accessibility snapshots than HTML, stable element refs, session isolation, search macros, and ~40MB idle memory, it serves as a drop-in replacement for Playwright/Puppeteer in AI automation and web scraping workflows.

repos.description: High-performance browser automation bridge and multi-instance orchestrator with advanced stealth injection and real-time dashboard.
repos.summary_zh: PinchTab 是专为 AI 智能体设计的高性能浏览器自动化桥接器。通过 12MB 的 Go 二进制文件提供 HTTP API，支持多实例 Chrome 进程 orchestration 与隐身注入。核心突破在于 token 效率——文本提取仅需 800 tokens/页，成本比截图方案低 5-13 倍。具备持久化配置文件、ARM64 优化和实时仪表板，是 AI 驱动 Web 自动化的轻量级基础设施。
repos.summary_en: PinchTab is a high-performance browser automation bridge designed for AI agents. This 12MB Go binary delivers HTTP API for multi-instance Chrome orchestration with advanced stealth injection. Its breakthrough is token efficiency—text extraction costs only 800 tokens/page, 5-13x cheaper than screenshots. Featuring persistent profiles, ARM64 optimization, and real-time dashboard, it's the lightweight infrastructure for AI-driven web automation.

repos.description: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: UI SDK 是一个为 AI 智能体设计的用户界面行为库，提供键盘导航、焦点管理、选择、弹出、拖放等交互行为，并内置 ARIA 无障碍支持。通过 @ui-sdk/core 定义原始组件，可无缝适配 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components，助力智能体快速生成下一代 UI。
repos.summary_en: UI SDK is a library of behaviors for AI agents to build next-generation user interfaces. It provides keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag-and-drop, and ARIA accessibility. Built on @ui-sdk/core, it offers adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, enabling agents to generate UIs seamlessly.

repos.description: Undetected version of the Playwright testing and automation library.
repos.summary_zh: Patchright 是 Playwright 的补丁增强版，专为 Chromium 浏览器打造，作为可直接替换的 undetected 自动化框架。通过修复 Runtime.enable、命令行参数等常见泄漏，有效绕过 Cloudflare、Akamai、Kasada 等反爬系统，支持 Python、NodeJS 与 .NET，适用于高隐蔽性网页爬虫与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: Patchright is a patched, undetected drop-in replacement for Playwright, focused on Chromium browsers. It fixes major detection leaks (Runtime.enable, automation flags, etc.) to bypass Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada and similar anti-bot systems. Available for Python, NodeJS and .NET, ideal for stealth web scraping and browser automation.

repos.description: OpenClaw: Use All Major AI Models NO API Token! Claude/ChatGPT/Gemini/DeepSeek/Doubao/Grok/Qwen/Manus/Kimi
repos.summary_zh: OpenClaw Zero Token 是 OpenClaw 的零 Token 分支，通过浏览器驱动官方网页 UI（Playwright CDP 自动化）实现无需 API Token 免费调用 Claude、ChatGPT、Gemini、DeepSeek、Qwen、Doubao、Kimi 等十余款主流大模型。提供统一 HTTP 网关、Web UI、CLI/TUI 接口，支持提示注入工具调用（web_search 等）和 AskOnce 多模型对比。本地存储凭证，无配额限制。适用于 AI 开发者构建智能体、模型测试及成本敏感场景。
repos.summary_en: OpenClaw Zero Token is a fork of OpenClaw focused on zero-token LLM access. It automates official web UIs via browser login (Playwright CDP) to freely call Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Doubao, Kimi and more through a unified gateway. Features include prompt-injected tool calling, AskOnce multi-model comparison, Web UI, CLI, and local credential storage. No API keys or quotas required. Ideal for developers building AI agents, model benchmarking, and cost-free LLM workflows on Node.js with Chrome.

repos.description: Extract any website’s design system into tokens in seconds: logo, colors, typography, borders & more. One command.
repos.summary_zh: Dembrandt 是一款一键提取任意网站设计系统的 CLI 工具。基于 Playwright 渲染页面并分析 DOM 计算样式，自动输出 Logo、颜色、字体、间距、边框、阴影、动效与组件等完整设计令牌，支持 W3C DTCG、shadcn/ui、Tailwind 等多格式导出，并可在 CI 中检测设计漂移，生成品牌指南或供 AI 代理使用。
repos.summary_en: Dembrandt is a CLI tool that extracts any website’s design system into standardized tokens in one command. Powered by Playwright, it analyzes computed DOM styles to capture logo, colors, typography, spacing, borders, shadows, motion and components. Outputs W3C DTCG, shadcn/ui, Tailwind themes and more; supports CI drift detection, brand guides and AI-agent ready DESIGN.md.

repos.description: Stealth browser automation for AI agents over MCP and the Chrome DevTools Protocol: navigation, network hooks, DOM extraction, and pixel-accurate UI cloning.
repos.summary_zh: Stealth Browser MCP 是专为 MCP 兼容 AI 智能体打造的不可检测浏览器自动化框架。基于 nodriver 与 Chrome DevTools Protocol，能有效绕过 Cloudflare、Queue-It 等反爬系统。核心亮点包括像素完美 UI 元素克隆（提取完整 CSS/DOM/事件）、网络流量拦截与 AI 动态生成 Python 钩子实现实时修改。提供 97 个模块化工具，支持最小化部署与跨平台运行（Windows/macOS/Linux/Docker）。无缝集成 Claude、Cursor 等 MCP 客户端，通过自然语言聊天执行高级浏览器任务，适用于受保护网站的网页抓取、自动化测试与数据提取。
repos.summary_en: Stealth Browser MCP delivers undetectable browser automation for MCP-compatible AI agents. Powered by nodriver and Chrome DevTools Protocol, it bypasses Cloudflare, Queue-It, and other anti-bot systems. Highlights include pixel-accurate UI cloning with full CSS/DOM extraction, comprehensive network interception, and an AI-driven dynamic hook system for real-time traffic modification via generated Python functions. It features 97 modular tools with minimal/core modes, cross-platform support (Windows, macOS, Linux, Docker), and seamless integration with Claude, Cursor, and other MCP clients. Enables natural language control for stealth web scraping, automated testing, and interactions on protected sites.

repos.description: Give your AI agent access to your live Chrome session — works out of the box, connects to tabs you already have open
repos.summary_zh: 让AI智能体直接操控正在使用的Chrome浏览器，无需重新登录或启动新实例。通过Chrome原生调试协议建立持久连接，支持截图、DOM操作、网络监控等能力。相比Puppeteer方案，可访问已登录状态，稳定处理百个标签页，适合需要与真实浏览器环境交互的智能体场景。
repos.summary_en: Enables AI agents to directly control your live Chrome session without relogin or new instances. Establishes persistent connections via Chrome's native debugging protocol, supporting screenshots, DOM manipulation, and network monitoring. Unlike Puppeteer-based solutions, it accesses authenticated states and reliably handles 100+ tabs, ideal for agents interacting with real browser environments.

repos.summary_zh: Google Gemini电脑使用预览版是基于Gemini 2.5模型的浏览器自动化代理工具。它通过自然语言指令直接控制浏览器执行搜索、填表等网页操作，集成Playwright实现本地浏览器控制，同时支持Vertex AI和Browserbase云端部署。开发者可通过Python CLI快速调用，体验Gemini模型的"计算机使用"能力，适用于网页自动化、测试和智能交互场景。
repos.summary_en: The Google Gemini Computer Use Preview is a browser automation agent powered by the Gemini 2.5 model. It translates natural language instructions into executable browser actions like searching and form filling. The tool leverages Playwright for local browser control and supports cloud deployment via Vertex AI and Browserbase. Accessed through a Python CLI, it demonstrates Gemini's 'computer use' capability, enabling developers to automate web interactions, testing, and intelligent browsing tasks through simple text commands.

repos.description: Advanced Privacy Browser Core with Unified Fingerprint Defense: Cloudflare, Akamai, Kasada, Shape, DataDome, PerimeterX, hCaptcha, FunCaptcha, Imperva, reCAPTCHA, ThreatMetrix, Adscore
repos.summary_zh: BotBrowser是一款专注于反浏览器指纹追踪的隐私浏览器核心。基于最新Chromium构建，通过统一指纹防御技术，在Windows、macOS、Linux等跨平台环境下保持完全一致的指纹特征，有效对抗Cloudflare、Akamai、Kasada等31+种高级追踪检测机制。支持Playwright/Puppeteer集成，提供QUIC/STUN全代理网络栈和毫秒级独立指纹切换，性能损耗低于1%。适用于隐私研究、反欺诈测试和自动化工具开发。
repos.summary_en: BotBrowser is a privacy-first browser core engineered to neutralize browser fingerprinting across platforms. Built on the latest Chromium, it maintains identical fingerprint signatures on Windows, macOS, and Linux, defeating over 31 tracking systems including Cloudflare, Akamai, and Kasada. Key features include Playwright/Puppeteer integration with CDP leak blocking, full QUIC/STUN proxy tunneling, per-context fingerprint isolation with millisecond switching, and benchmark-proven performance parity with Chrome. Designed for privacy research and authorized defensive benchmarking.

repos.summary_zh: reg-factory 是一套全自动注册流水线：批量自注册 Outlook 邮箱，再用同一邮箱在 ChatGPT/Grok/Claude 上注册账号并导出直登 Cookie。核心采用比特浏览器实现指纹隔离、Clash Verge 代理节点切换绕过区域与 Cloudflare 限制，结合接码打码服务完成验证。基于 Python + Playwright 构建，适用于 AI 服务批量测试与账号管理场景。
repos.summary_en: reg-factory is a fully automated registration pipeline: batch self-register Outlook emails, then use them to create accounts on ChatGPT/Grok/Claude and export direct-login cookies. It uses BitBrowser for fingerprint isolation, Clash Verge for proxy switching to bypass geo-blocks and Cloudflare, plus SMS/captcha services. Built on Python + Playwright, ideal for bulk AI service testing and account management.

repos.description: Turn your Telegram Channel into a MicroBlog.
repos.summary_zh: BroadcastChannel 是一个基于 Astro 的工具，可将 Telegram 频道转化为轻量级微型博客。它无需浏览器端 JavaScript，提供 SEO 友好的站点地图和 RSS 订阅，支持 Cloudflare、Vercel 等无服务器部署。用户只需配置频道用户名，即可快速搭建独立博客，实现内容同步与自定义域名绑定。
repos.summary_en: BroadcastChannel transforms your Telegram channel into a lightweight microblog using Astro. It requires zero client-side JavaScript, delivers SEO-friendly sitemaps and RSS feeds, and supports deployment on serverless platforms like Cloudflare and Vercel. Simply configure your channel username to launch a standalone blog with custom domain support.

repos.description: A wrapper that exposes Google AI Studio Build as OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic compatible APIs.（一个将 Google AI Studio Build 封装为兼容 OpenAI / Gemini / Anthropic 风格 API 的工具）
repos.summary_zh: AIStudioToAPI 是一个将 Google AI Studio 网页端封装为兼容 OpenAI、Gemini 和 Anthropic API 格式的代理工具。它利用浏览器自动化技术实现多账号管理、工具调用及生图/TTS 模型访问，提供可视化 Web 控制台和 VNC 登录功能，便于开发者将 AI Studio 能力无缝集成到现有应用。
repos.summary_en: AIStudioToAPI is a wrapper that converts Google AI Studio's web interface into OpenAI, Gemini, and Anthropic-compatible API formats. Leveraging browser automation, it supports multi-account management, function calling, and access to Gemini models for image generation and text-to-speech. The tool provides a web console with VNC login capabilities, enabling seamless integration of AI Studio features into existing applications.

repos.description: Free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher for web scraping and multi-accounting. By the ShardX team (formerly ProxyShard). Engine-level fingerprint spoofing in Chromium 158 (WebGL / WebGPU / Client Hints / fonts / TLS), 220+ device profiles bundled, stable QUIC + WebRTC over SOCKS5.
repos.summary_zh: ShardX 是开源反检测浏览器启动器，基于修改版 Chromium 152 引擎实现多层指纹伪装，内置 220+ 设备配置，支持 SOCKS5 代理下 QUIC/WebRTC，提供多语言 SDK 与 MCP 服务，适用于网页爬虫与多账号管理。
repos.summary_en: ShardX is a free, open-source anti-detect browser launcher built on a patched Chromium 152 engine with deep fingerprint spoofing across WebGL, WebGPU, Client Hints, fonts, and TLS layers. It bundles 220+ device profiles, supports stable QUIC and WebRTC over SOCKS5 proxies, and provides multi-language SDKs for Python, Node.js, and Rust along with a local API and MCP server. Designed by the ProxyShard team, it is ideal for web scraping and multi-account management workflows at scale.

repos.description: WebAI2API: 基于 Camoufox 的网页 AI 转 API 工具，支持 LMArena/Gemini等，多窗口并发与账号隔离。 | Web AI to OpenAI API via Camoufox. Supports LMArena/Gemini and more, multi-window concurrency & account isolation.
repos.summary_zh: WebAI2API是基于Camoufox的网页AI服务转API工具，支持LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT等20+平台。通过拟人化操作模拟规避检测，提供OpenAI格式接口，支持多窗口并发与账号级浏览器隔离，内置任务队列和故障转移机制，配备可视化管理界面，实现高效稳定的AI服务调用。
repos.summary_en: WebAI2API converts web-based AI services (LMArena/Gemini/ChatGPT etc.) into OpenAI-compatible APIs using Camoufox. It simulates human-like interactions to bypass detection, supports multi-window concurrency with account isolation, and includes task queuing, failover mechanisms, plus a web management interface for stable AI service integration.

repos.description: Outlook 注册机
repos.summary_zh: OutlookRegister 是一款自动化 Outlook/Hotmail 账号注册工具，基于 Patchright/Playwright 模拟人类填表行为，支持自动过验证码、代理池与并发，集成 moemail 临时邮箱或 Outlook Graph API 辅助验证，可将成功账号存储至 Results 目录，适用于批量账号获取场景。
repos.summary_en: OutlookRegister is an automated Outlook/Hotmail account registration tool using Patchright/Playwright to simulate human form-filling, with auto captcha solving, proxy pools, concurrency, and support for moemail temp emails or Outlook Graph API verification. Successful accounts are saved to Results, ideal for bulk account generation.

repos.description: Free open-source Multilogin/Incogniton/Kameleo alternative for fingerprint spoofing (Canvas/WebGL/User-Agent). Perfect for Selenium/Playwright/Puppeteer automation, web scraping, social media bots, ads verification, and multi-accounting based on chromium. Avoid bans, bypass anti-bot systems, and prevent tracking with customizable stealth browsing
repos.summary_zh: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser 是一款基于 Chromium 的开源反检测浏览器，提供全面的指纹欺骗能力，覆盖 Canvas、WebGL、字体等关键维度。其独家一致性分析引擎确保所有欺骗字段逻辑自洽，有效绕过反机器人系统。内置自动化模块完美兼容 Playwright/Puppeteer，适用于网络爬虫、社交媒体多账号运营及广告验证等场景，是 Multilogin 等商业方案的开源替代。
repos.summary_en: Undetectable Fingerprint Browser is an open-source anti-detection browser built on Chromium that delivers comprehensive fingerprint spoofing for Canvas, WebGL, fonts, and more. Its exclusive consistency analysis engine ensures logical alignment across all spoofed fields to effectively bypass anti-bot systems. With built-in automation modules fully compatible with Playwright/Puppeteer, it's ideal for web scraping, social media multi-account management, and ad verification, offering a powerful free alternative to commercial solutions like Multilogin.

repos.description: Terminal UI to get stuff done in the browser
repos.summary_zh: Browser Use Terminal 是一个基于 Rust 的终端 UI 工具，用于让 LLM 代理自动化控制浏览器完成真实任务。它通过直接 CDP 连接操作真实 Chrome 会话，支持无头模式和云端执行，提供可交互的终端界面来观察、控制和恢复任务。核心优势在于 2倍成本效益和速度提升，适用于需要认证状态的企业 Web 应用自动化。
repos.summary_en: Browser Use Terminal is a Rust-based TUI that enables LLM agents to automate browser tasks via direct CDP control. It leverages real Chrome sessions with existing login states, supports headless and cloud execution, and offers an interactive interface for task monitoring and intervention. The custom LLM harness achieves 2x cost reduction and performance gains, perfect for complex authenticated web workflows.

repos.description: A tiny TypeScript web agent, hill climbed on real browser evals.
repos.summary_zh: 基于Pi Mono与CDP的TypeScript浏览器智能体，通过持久化V8 REPL执行JavaScript控制Chrome，支持会话保持、登录态复用、流式输出与无障碍树交互，适用于网页自动化与数据采集。
repos.summary_en: A lightweight TypeScript web agent built on Pi Mono LLM and raw Chrome DevTools Protocol, using a persistent V8 REPL to execute JavaScript and control Chrome browsers. The agent dynamically writes its own helper functions, supporting session persistence, saved logins, streaming output, typed results, and accessibility-tree interaction. Designed for browser automation, web scraping, and data collection tasks, with cloud browser support requiring no local Chrome installation. Features include ultrafast mode for interaction-heavy tasks, interaction highlights, screen recordings, and GIF exports for visual debugging.

repos.description: 微信读书全本导出工具 — Playwright + Canvas Hook 提取完整书籍内容为 Markdown
repos.summary_zh: 微信读书全本导出工具，通过Playwright自动化浏览器并Hook Canvas fillText方法，拦截渲染文本，结合y坐标拆分双页内容，按坐标重建段落并清理格式，导出为Markdown。适用于个人学习研究，需有效微信读书账号权限。技术亮点包括持久化登录、双页处理及文本重建，支持章节独立输出与元数据保存，解决网页版无法直接复制的问题。
repos.summary_en: weread-exporter exports complete WeRead books to Markdown by using Playwright to automate Chromium and hooking CanvasRenderingContext2D.fillText to capture canvas-rendered text. It splits double-page renders via y-coordinate detection, reconstructs paragraphs from (x,y) coordinates, and cleans formatting. Designed for personal study with valid account access, it features persistent QR login, per-chapter Markdown files, metadata JSON, and optional raw data. Addresses web version copy restrictions with ~20-30s per chapter speed.

repos.description: Automated QwenCloud account registration & API key harvester with multi-threading, TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth
repos.summary_zh: QwenCloud Generator是一款自动化QwenCloud账户注册与API密钥采集工具，支持多线程Playwright浏览器并发操作、TUI实时仪表盘监控、代理轮换及Gmail OAuth邮箱验证。适用于AI开发者批量获取Qwen大模型API访问权限的场景，具备无头模式、自动恢复和页面状态智能检测等亮点，大幅提升注册效率与匿名性。
repos.summary_en: QwenCloud Generator automates QwenCloud account registration and API key harvesting using multi-threaded Playwright browsers, a TUI dashboard, proxy rotation, and Gmail OAuth for verification. Ideal for AI developers needing bulk API access to Qwen models, it supports headless mode via Xvfb, auto-resume, and scenario detection to handle signup flows efficiently and scalably.

repos.description: 🤖 An AI-powered desktop automation agent built with Electron &   Next.js - Control your computer like manus, but as a native   desktop app, an ai browser!
repos.summary_zh: 基于Electron与Next.js的AI桌面自动化浏览器，实现类Manus的计算机控制。核心特性：双模式交互（ChatAgent轻量对话/Deep Explore多智能体工作流）、多模态任务执行、可视化定时调度。支持DeepSeek/Qwen/Gemini等AI提供商，集成Tavily/Serper搜索与MCP服务。采用React 19+Zustand架构，提供原生桌面体验，适用于智能办公、研究分析与自动化场景。
repos.summary_en: An AI-powered desktop automation browser built with Electron and Next.js that enables Manus-like computer control through a native application. Key features include dual-mode interaction (ChatAgent for lightweight conversations vs. Deep Explore for multi-agent workflows), multi-modal task execution, and visual scheduling. Supports major AI providers (DeepSeek, Qwen, Gemini, Claude) with integrated search engines (Tavily/Serper) and MCP services. Built on React 19+Zustand architecture, it delivers native desktop experience for intelligent office work, research analysis, and automation scenarios.

repos.description: hotmail register
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个基于Python的Outlook/Hotmail自动化注册工具，采用ruyiPage库驱动Firefox浏览器实现全流程自动化。支持批量注册、代理IP、验证码服务集成及无头模式，可生成虚假注册信息并保存账号凭证。适用于测试研究等非商业场景，采用PolyForm非商用许可证。
repos.summary_en: This Python automation tool leverages ruyiPage library to control Firefox browser for fully automated Outlook/Hotmail account registration. Key features include bulk account creation with configurable delays, proxy server support for IP rotation, integration with 2captcha for automated captcha solving, headless mode operation, and fake identity generation using Faker library. Designed specifically for testing and research purposes under PolyForm Noncommercial 1.0.0 license, it automatically saves credentials to text files with comprehensive logging and screenshot capture capabilities.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供半自动 NVIDIA BUILD 账号注册工具，使用 Playwright 浏览器自动化完成邮箱创建、注册表单、验证码填写及 NGC API Key 生成，仅手动处理 hCaptcha。集成自建临时邮箱服务，实现端到端流程自动化。核心价值在于简化开发者获取 NVIDIA AI Playground 密钥的流程，节省重复操作时间。技术亮点包括 Playwright 端到端控制、邮件轮询验证与 API 调用集成。仅限学习交流用途。
repos.summary_en: This repository provides a semi-automated tool for registering NVIDIA BUILD accounts and generating AI Playground API keys. It uses Playwright for browser automation to handle email creation via a self-hosted temp mail service, form submissions, verification code polling, and NGC API key creation, requiring only manual hCaptcha solving. Core value lies in streamlining access to NVIDIA AI tools for developers. Technical highlights include end-to-end browser control, email integration, and automated API interactions. Intended solely for educational purposes.

repos.summary_zh: 这个Python工具用于自动化破解阿里云滑动验证码。核心价值：通过OpenCV图像识别精准定位缺口位置，结合Selenium浏览器自动化模拟人类滑动轨迹，有效绕过阿里云验证码防护。应用场景：网络爬虫数据采集、自动化测试。技术亮点：集成ddddocr识别、undetected-chromedriver防检测、人类行为模拟算法，支持跨平台运行。
repos.summary_en: This Python tool automates bypassing Alibaba Cloud slider captchas. Its core value lies in using OpenCV for precise gap detection and Selenium for human-like drag simulation to effectively circumvent Aliyun captcha protection. It is ideal for web scraping data collection and automated testing scenarios. Key technical highlights include integration with ddddocr for recognition, undetected-chromedriver for anti-detection, sophisticated human behavior simulation algorithms, and full cross-platform compatibility across Windows, Linux, and macOS.
